## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

**2026-06-23 — Anthropic launched Claude Tag for Slack**  
Link: https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag  
Summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Tag, a beta for Claude Enterprise and Team customers that lets users tag `@Claude` in Slack channels, delegate tasks, and give Claude scoped access to workplace tools, data, and codebases. It adds persistent channel context, scoped memories, admin controls, spend visibility, and logging.  
Why it matters: Enterprise assistants are moving from chat windows into ambient collaboration surfaces with memory, permissions, and auditability.
